reasoning: This gazette notification involves the Minister of Education exercising powers under the Universities Act to amend degree programs offered by a private educational institution (International College of Business and Technology Limited). While it mentions a government minister by name, the core content focuses on educational matters - specifically the recognition and regulation of degree programs at a private institution, including admission requirements and accreditation conditions. This falls under educational administration, which is categorized as Miscellaneous (Type 10) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
